plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he has a friend in Marin County, California, who has the same kind of slit in his eye that Strieber has. He says this friend is one of the world's leading experts on Konstantin Raudive, a man known for studying mysterious voices on tape recordings. Strieber tells it as if the shared mark were a link between people drawn to unusual subjects.
